name: 低多边形游戏风

source.library: RHSTORY 画风库（服务端全量）
source.original_name: 低多边形游戏风 ｜ Low Poly Game Style

style_tokens: low poly 3d game asset, faceted flat-shaded polygons, visible triangular planes, soft ambient occlusion, clear key light with rim light, unified color scheme, simple clean background, isometric-friendly
negative_extra: photorealistic, high-poly detail, fur, hair strands, text, watermark, noisy texture, painterly brush strokes
sprite_hint: 要「3D 感但零渲染成本」：出图后不要加真实阴影层，明暗已烘进贴图；同一物件保持固定 45° 视角
risk: 视角容易乱（同一批素材有的俯视有的平视）→ 提示词必须锁死视角与光位
notes: 想要「像 3D 游戏」但不想付 WebGL 代价时的首选：静态贴图 + Phaser 2D 呈现。
